checks.method: Static source review of private Envelope.init(from:)
checks.observed: schemaVersion must decode as Int and equal currentSchemaVersion. The complete allKeys set must equal schemaVersion/name/scene; missing or extra top-level names reject. name and scene are decoded as typed nonoptional values. Envelope is private and public document has no Decodable bypass.

Missing schemaVersion raises a decoding error translated to invalidDocument. With schemaVersion 1, missing name/scene and any extra top-level member fail the exact key-set guard. Null or wrong-type required values fail typed decoding. Unsupported integer versions fail with unsupportedVersion before scene decoding.

checks.method: Static source review and authored regression inspection
checks.observed: After Foundation accepts the typed closed envelope, requireUniqueObjectKeys scans object scopes, decodes quoted key tokens, and rejects a repeated exact UTF-8 key. Literal and escaped top-level spellings therefore cannot hide duplicate name/scene/schemaVersion fields. Duplicate-envelope tests include reversed version/name order, repeated scene, and escaped equivalent key forms. An unsupported chosen version can reject earlier with unsupportedVersion; both paths fail closed.

Scanner consumes complete quoted strings including escapes before structural dispatch. Authored regression verifies quoted member-like text, braces, brackets, slashes, and emoji inside names remain readable, plus deterministic encode/decode.

Decode checks the byte limit, decodes the private envelope, requires unambiguous keys, then invokes validated value construction. No document is returned following failure and this file performs no library mutations. Foundation decoding failures translate to invalidDocument; documented unsupported-version/name/scene and too-large cases remain distinct.

Inspected all five test methods: duplicate values in either order; escaped equivalent key duplicates; escaped unique keys and structural text; Foundation-supported Unicode encodings; large valid name and exact byte-boundary padding. The focused file does not separately enumerate missing/unknown top-level-member cases or assert exact error categories for all duplicate cases.
